result.topic_en: A German-language rule expressing the quantities 4Θ, 4Θ', 4Θ'', 4Θ''' in terms of the results G, g, H, h of earlier prescriptions II–V plus corrections R, R', R'', R''' built from parenthesised sign quantities, checked on a worked example and summed to give S.
result.transcription:
Hieraus fliesst folgende Regel. Es sei
das Resultat aus den Vorschriften
II ... $G$
III ... $g$
IV ... $H$
V ... $h$
So ist
$4\Theta = R = 0$
$4\Theta' = -g + G - h - H + R'$
$4\Theta'' = -2g + 2G + R''$
$4\Theta''' = -g + G + h + H + R'''$
In unserm Beispiele ist
$G = 0 \quad H = -1 \quad | R' = 0$
$g = -1 \quad h = +2 \quad | R'' = +2$
$R''' = [-?-]2$
$4\Theta = 0$
$4\Theta' = +1 -1 +0 = 0$
$4\Theta'' = +2 +2 = +4$
$4\Theta''' = +1 +1 -2 = 0$
und die Correctionen $R, R'$ &c. werden so bestimmt: Es ist
$R = \begin{cases} -(\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ -\tfrac12(b) - \tfrac12(B) \\ +(\mathfrak{b}) [-?-] \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) - \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ +\tfrac12(b) + \tfrac12(B) \end{cases}$
wo die in Parenthesi stehenden Grössen bloss ihr Zeichen hergeben.
$R' = \begin{cases} +(\alpha) - \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ -\tfrac12(b) [-?-] \tfrac12(A) \\ 0 \\ -\tfrac12(a) + \tfrac12(B) \end{cases}$
$R'' = \begin{cases} + (\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ -\tfrac12(b) + \tfrac12(B) \\ +(\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ -\tfrac12(b) + \tfrac12(B) \end{cases}$
$R''' = \begin{cases} -(\alpha) - \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}) + \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) \\ -\tfrac12(b) + \tfrac12(A) \\ 0 \\ +\tfrac12(a) + \tfrac12(B) \end{cases}$
Es ist also
$R + R' + R'' + R''' =$
$2(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) - 2(b) + 2(B)$ [?]
$+ 2(\mathfrak{b})$
folglich
$\Theta + \Theta' + \Theta'' + \Theta''' = -g + G$
$+ \tfrac12(\alpha\mathfrak{b}ab AB) + \tfrac12(\mathfrak{b})$
$- \tfrac12(b) + \tfrac12(B)$
$= S$
